title: FGEN Presentation to Strathcona High School's Psychology 20 Students
description: I remember when I took psychology 20 in grade 10. It was an amazing experience, and I remembered when a few lessons touched on the brain. Being able to present the brain and mental health to the psych 20 class was a great experience, especially since I got to present to a lot of my peers as well!

description: Leadership plays a vital role in the lives of children and youth. I was grateful for the opportunity to present on how the brain and mental health empower young people to lead with confidence and purpose!
